body.en:
Question B-001-012-001.

Why the correct answer is right: Third-party messages sent by an amateur station must not be compensated; no payment of any kind is allowed.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "Donation of amateur radio equipment": A donation of equipment is still a thing of value connected to the message handling, so it is not allowed as payment.
- sourceIndex 2: "Donation of equipment repairs": Repair work is also compensation; changing the form of payment does not make it permissible.
- sourceIndex 3: "Any amount agreed upon in advance": An agreed amount in advance is exactly the sort of payment the rule excludes.
